chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Hasan ibn Abi al-Husayn al-Farisi, from Sulayman ibn Ja'far al-Ja'fari, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The people of the Quran are at the highest rank among human beings, except for the Prophets and the Messengers. Therefore, do not belittle the people of the Quran in their rights, for they have from God, the Mighty, the Compeller, a lofty position.'

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْقُرْآنِ: People of the Quran — those who memorize, recite, and live by the Quran
key_terms.الْآدَمِيُّون: Human beings (children of Adam), all of humanity
key_terms.الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّار: The Mighty, the Compeller — two of the Divine Names emphasizing God's irresistible power
key_terms.مَكَانٌ عَلِيّ: A lofty position — an exalted station with God

ai.seo_question: What rank do the people of the Quran hold according to the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrates that the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declared that those who bear, memorize, and embody the Quran occupy the highest station among all humans, second only to the prophets and messengers. The hadith commands believers not to disregard or undermine the rights and dignity of the bearers of the Quran, for God the Almighty has bestowed upon them an exalted position. This teaching was directed to a community that needed to recognize the special honor due to those devoted to the Quran.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Hassan Bin Abu Al Husayn Al Farsy, from Suleyman Bin Ja’far Al Ja’fary, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The people of the Quran would be in the highest Levels from the human beings except for the Prophetsas and the Mursils Prophetsas. Therefore, you should not consider them weaken in the matter of their rights, for there is for them, from Allahazwj the Mighty, the Compeller, a lofty position’’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Hassan ibn abu al-Husayn al-Farsi from Sulayman ibn Ja’far from his father al-Ja’fari from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

‘‘The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘People of the Holy Quran are of the highest degree among men, except the prophets and the messengers of Allah, thus, you should not consider them weak in the matters of their rights; with Allah, the Most Majestic, the Almighty, they have a special status.’”
